title: S1562 (2019 Regular): Exceptions to Requirements for the Purchase and Sale of Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Introduced, 2019-02-28; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2019/1562/BillText/Filed/HTML (LegiScan doc 1940210))
provenance.note: Introduced version (filed 2019-02-28); no passage vote. Sections 1, 4-8 also change the "law enforcement officer" definition and update cross-references in ss. 790.06, 790.115, 790.145, 810.095 and 921.0024 (conforming).

operative_text:
Section 1 (s. 790.001, F.S.): (7) “Holder of a concealed weapons permit” means a holder of a license issued under s. 790.06 or a full-time, part-time, or auxiliary law enforcement officer, as defined in s. 943.10, who is certified under chapter 943.
Section 2 (s. 790.0655, F.S.): (a) When a firearm is being purchased by a holder of a concealed weapons permit.
Section 3 (new s. 790.0656, F.S.): 790.0656 Sale of firearms; county requirements; exceptions.—Waiting period requirements adopted by a county pursuant to s. 5(b), Art. VIII of the State Constitution in connection with the sale of a firearm occurring within the county do not apply if the firearm is being purchased by a holder of a concealed weapons permit.
higher_law_duty: Preamble (WHEREAS clauses) cites s. 8(b), Art. I and s. 5(b), Art. VIII of the State Constitution, which exempt holders of a concealed weapons permit from handgun/firearm waiting periods.
